d7Settings.nav.label: Settings
d7Settings.saveFailed: That didn't save, and nothing changed. Try again.
d7Settings.banner.title: Your account will be deleted on {date}.
d7Settings.banner.body: Until then you can use it as normal, and cancel any time.
d7Settings.account.intro: Your name, picture, email and what channels can see about you.
d7Settings.account.profile.title: Profile
d7Settings.account.profile.intro: Channels see this name and picture in chat and on your profile.
d7Settings.account.name.label: Display name
d7Settings.account.name.hint: Up to {max} characters. You can change it any time.
d7Settings.account.name.failed: Your display name didn't save, and nothing changed. Try again.
d7Settings.account.username.label: Username
d7Settings.account.username.hint: Your username is also your channel address and never changes.
d7Settings.account.avatar.label: Picture
d7Settings.account.avatar.hint: Square works best. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {mb} MB. Your channel can use its own picture, set in the studio.
d7Settings.account.avatar.noChannel: Your picture uses your channel's uploads, and this account has no channel.
d7Settings.account.avatar.tooLarge: That file is too large. Choose one up to {mb} MB.
d7Settings.account.avatar.failed: Your picture didn't save, and nothing changed. Try again.
d7Settings.account.email.title: Email
d7Settings.account.email.intro: Where we send sign-in links, receipts and the alerts you turn on.
d7Settings.account.email.masked: We show it partly hidden so it's safe on a shared screen.
d7Settings.account.email.sent: If this address needs it, a new link is on its way.
d7Settings.account.email.rateLimited: We sent a link a moment ago. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
d7Settings.account.email.failed: The link wasn't sent. Try again.
d7Settings.account.visibility.title: What channels see
d7Settings.account.visibility.intro: Choose what the channels you follow can see about you.
d7Settings.account.shareEmail.label: Share my email with channels I follow
d7Settings.account.shareEmail.hint: They can email you about their streams. They never see it otherwise.
d7Settings.account.mature.label: Mature content
d7Settings.account.mature.confirmedOn: You confirmed you're 18 or older on {date}. 18+ streams play without asking again.
d7Settings.account.mature.confirmed: You confirmed you're 18 or older. 18+ streams play without asking again.
d7Settings.account.mature.notConfirmed: Not confirmed. An 18+ stream asks you first.
d7Settings.account.mature.confirmBody: 18+ streams will ask you to confirm your age again before they play.
d7Settings.account.mature.withdrawn: 18+ streams are off. They'll ask before they play.
d7Settings.account.danger.title: Delete your account
d7Settings.account.danger.body: See what happens first, and download your data, on Privacy & data.
d7Settings.prefs.intro: How this site looks, reads and plays for you.
d7Settings.prefs.notKept: This browser didn't keep the setting, so it lasts until you close the tab.
d7Settings.prefs.theme.title: Theme
d7Settings.prefs.theme.intro: The same choice as in your account menu.
d7Settings.prefs.playback.title: Playback
d7Settings.prefs.playback.intro: How streams play on this device.
d7Settings.prefs.playback.perDevice: These settings apply to this device only.
d7Settings.prefs.dataSaver.label: Data saver
d7Settings.prefs.dataSaver.hint: Start streams at a lower quality to use less data. You can change it on any stream.
d7Settings.prefs.autoplay.label: Play previews by themselves
d7Settings.prefs.autoplay.hint: Stream previews may move and play muted. Off if your device asks for less motion.
d7Settings.privacy.intro: Get a copy of what we hold about you, choose who can reach you, or delete your account.
d7Settings.privacy.download.title: Download your data
d7Settings.privacy.download.bundleHint: Everything another server needs to take your channel and followers. You prepare it on the Move page.
d7Settings.privacy.who.title: Who can see you
d7Settings.delete.title: Delete your account
d7Settings.delete.intro: You get {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to change your mind. After that, your profile, channel and messages are deleted. Payments, the ledger, votes and audit history stay, with your name and email removed.
d7Settings.delete.dialogIntro: Here's what happens to @{username}. You have {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to cancel.
d7Settings.delete.impact.removed: Removed: your profile, sign-in methods, chat messages, videos and clips.
d7Settings.delete.impact.kept: Kept, with your name and email removed: payments, the ledger, votes and audit history. The law and the co-op's books need them.
d7Settings.delete.impact.subscriptions: {count, plural, one {The # subscription you pay for ends} other {The # subscriptions you pay for end}} when your account is deleted, with nothing more charged and no refund for the rest of the period.
d7Settings.delete.impact.subscriptionsLi: To stop paying sooner, cancel on your subscriptions page now.
d7Settings.delete.impact.channelSubscrip: {count, plural, one {# paid subscription to your channel ends} other {# paid subscriptions to your channel end}} when your account is deleted.
d7Settings.delete.impact.payout: {amount} you've earned and haven't been paid yet is still owed to you. It's paid under the co-op's payout rules.
d7Settings.delete.impact.membership: Your co-op membership ends. Votes you've already cast still count.
d7Settings.delete.impact.share: Your co-op membership ends, and your {amount} member share is refunded under the bylaws. The treasurer arranges the refund. Votes you've already cast still count.
d7Settings.delete.impact.legalHold: Some records are under a legal hold. They're kept for as long as the hold lasts, linked to your account only by a number.
d7Settings.delete.previewFailed: We couldn't load what applies to your account. The lines above are true for everyone.
d7Settings.delete.downloaded: I downloaded my data, or I don't need it.
d7Settings.delete.preparing: Your download is being prepared. We'll email you a link.
d7Settings.delete.confirm: Delete in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
d7Settings.delete.scheduledToast: Deletion scheduled. We emailed you the date.
d7Settings.delete.cancelFailed: The deletion is still scheduled. Try again.
d7Settings.copyright.title: Notices about your content
d7Settings.copyright.intro: Each notice, what was removed, and how to send a counter-notice.
d7Settings.connections.title: Apps you authorized
d7Settings.connections.intro: Apps you let use your account, what each one may do, and how to cut it off.
